headline: Zloty recovers losses. Franc, dollar and pound quickly fall from their peaks
summary: The zloty strengthened against the franc, dollar and pound on Tuesday after weakening on Monday amid a euro sell-off and a stronger dollar. Investors are positioning ahead of the two-day Monetary Policy Council meeting.
why: The Polish zloty is the currency of Poland, and the Monetary Policy Council sets the country's benchmark interest rates.
